entries.name: Member-scoped assistant
entries.summary: Give an installed agent a goal; review its proposed actions before confirming them.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Agent run and execution chain
entries.summary: Inspect the original run trace, structured drafts and cross-application execution links.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Application sessions
entries.summary: Share declared presentation state across pages of one scoped application instance.
constraints: Application owns scalar declarations and bounded queries. Pages use typed shared bindings; windows remain read-only, ephemeral and member-scoped.

entries.name: Controlled page composition
entries.summary: Render original Page sections with shared selection and filters; composition disables writes.
constraints: Named record selections keep same-object lists independent; parent bindings scope related sections.
Form inputs read declared record paths. The original action checks writes; unavailable sources do not become manual inputs.

entries.name: Published code function call
entries.summary: Bind a published Go/Wasm operation to a page using its original owner contract.
constraints: A runtime call needs the actual host, a published owner revision and the current member’s permissions.
The offline preview shows the binding only and never executes Wasm or reads tenant data.
entries.snippet:
import { ComputeCall } from "@platform/app";
<ComputeCall binding={publishedOperation} bindings={inputs} record={selected} recordType="your.object" />

entries.name: Bound dashboard
entries.summary: Render the existing chart specification over the member’s permitted aggregates.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Authorized workflow run
entries.summary: Inspect a workflow's recorded version and startup release through the member's original read permissions.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Generated record form
entries.summary: Edit fields from the original object declaration; submit through the owning action.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.
entries.snippet:
import { GeneratedForm } from "@platform/app";
<GeneratedForm type="your.object" submitLabel="Create" onSubmit={submit} onCancel={cancel} />

entries.name: Authorized cross-application search
entries.summary: Search records and knowledge through the current member’s original read endpoints.
constraints: Results come from the current member’s host. The offline example searches synthetic records only.
This search currently has no dedicated error or pending feedback; callers must not claim otherwise.

entries.name: Page workspace and preview
entries.summary: The same list-detail descriptor serves a live workspace and a read-only sample preview.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Declared action controls
entries.summary: Render original action payloads and offered transitions without duplicating role rules.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.
entries.snippet:
import { RecordActions } from "@platform/app";
<RecordActions type="your.object" record={record} steps />

entries.name: Authorized record detail
entries.summary: Read a record with history, tasks and the actions offered to the current member.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Authorized record list
entries.summary: Browse records, choose a record and save a list view through the member’s host.
constraints: Connect through the workspace Host. The Catalog preview uses local fixtures and grants no permissions.

entries.name: Typed semantic selection
entries.summary: Choose an authorized object or property from the existing registry without writing internal identifiers.
constraints: The selector returns typed references. Host validation and original permissions remain authoritative.

entries.name: Semantic tokens
entries.summary: Use shared surface, text, focus and status tokens across themes.
constraints: Use semantic tokens instead of assigning domain meaning to raw colors.

entries.name: Master-detail interaction
entries.summary: Keep selection and detail together using the existing record workspace or controlled table/detail sections.
constraints: List selection is shared by details and actions. The object contract and current member’s read scope remain authoritative.
This pattern recommends a composition; it does not grant widget eligibility or permissions.

entries.name: App Shell / Workspace
entries.summary: Compose app navigation, routed tabs, commands and session context in one shell.
constraints: Applications reuse Workspace; app navigation and views come from their AppUI declaration.
Open this full-window preview separately; its shell owns routes and saved layout.

entries.name: Application release workbench
entries.summary: Organize navigation and shared published objects, workflows and functions with the original application editor.
constraints: The local example uses synthetic application membership. Save, release and navigation actions cannot reach a host.
Application resources refer to original owners; membership does not grant access. Release review freezes published dependencies using the existing candidate path.

entries.name: Logic design workbench
entries.summary: Compose typed platform blocks with the existing native workflow editor and shared canvas.
constraints: The local example demonstrates a payload and result flow in the original WorkflowEditor; it does not execute a process.
Installed blocks, versions, permissions, testing and activation come from the connected owner APIs.

entries.name: Object design workbench
entries.summary: Inspect and edit fields, lifecycle states, transitions and access through the existing object designer.
constraints: This is the existing ProcessEditor with synthetic local data. Save and publish are refused in Catalog.
A tenant object must be created, tested and published in the connected Application Studio.
Action conditions compare declared record paths or inputs with a fixed value or another compatible field; related reads and approval retries use the original action and current requester permissions.

entries.name: Reusable query workbench
entries.summary: Author fixed record conditions and retain explicit query versions for shared page plans.
constraints: The local example uses synthetic query and object descriptors. Save and publication cannot reach a host.
Queries use the original record reader and member permissions. Pages explicitly choose a retained source version; later drafts and publications do not replace it.

entries.name: Record handling workspace
entries.summary: Select a record, inspect its details and use the original object actions.
constraints: Studio requires an object and visible fields; actions are chosen from the current member’s original action catalog.
The output is a build.page draft. It never publishes, generates tenant TSX or bypasses release validation.
Template identity and revision are recorded in the editable page description as informative provenance.

entries.name: Workshop module migration
entries.summary: Map a bounded source page into the original V2 draft with explicit bindings, source preservation and blocking diagnostics.
constraints: The 92-type migration inventory grants no runtime eligibility. Eight source widget types have bounded configuration profiles; unsupported settings block application.
The local example compiles synthetic source data without a host. Import applies only an undoable page draft; save, permissions and release validation stay with their original owners.
Download the original JSON and mapping report before leaving the editor. Reports remain in the current editing scope until it closes or its member changes.

entries.name: Typed block canvas
entries.summary: Compose nodes through typed ports with one shared graph interaction model.
constraints: The canvas owns interaction; its caller owns graph semantics, validation and persistence.

entries.name: Button
entries.summary: One action control with primary, quiet, destructive, link and row variants.

entries.name: Button group
entries.summary: Activate stable scoped presentation controls through caller-owned bindings.
constraints: Each control has a stable identity; the caller owns its binding, permissions and execution.

entries.name: Chart
entries.summary: Render a visualization spec using inline values or a scoped aggregate source.

entries.name: Checkbox
entries.summary: A labelled boolean choice with an explicit disabled state.

entries.name: Collection title
entries.summary: Show a declared collection name and its caller-owned complete count.
constraints: The caller owns the authorized complete count and clears obsolete values.

entries.name: Context commands
entries.summary: Use the same commands from a pointer context menu or an explicit keyboard and touch trigger.
constraints: The caller owns commands and disabled states; the menu does not perform business operations itself.

entries.name: Content tabs
entries.summary: Switch stable named panels with keyboard navigation and retain visited content.

entries.name: Data table
entries.summary: Browse, sort and edit typed rows in a shared virtualized table.

entries.name: Modal dialog
entries.summary: Ask for a bounded decision with focus trapping and a labelled title.

entries.name: Disclosure
entries.summary: Reveal supporting details while keeping the summary visible.

entries.name: Editor workbench
entries.summary: Arrange a library, canvas and inspector with keyboard and pointer pane resizing.

entries.name: Record summary
entries.summary: Present a record's title, status and labelled properties.

entries.name: Schema form
entries.summary: Render labelled editors and validate an ad hoc schema before submission.

entries.name: Facet choices
entries.summary: Choose several authorized options with complete source counts and an optional histogram.
constraints: The caller owns authorized options, counts and typed selected values.

entries.name: Typed field vocabulary
entries.summary: One field type owns display, editing, validation, sorting and filtering.
constraints: Reference links need a Workspace; attachment upload needs an explicit caller implementation.

entries.name: File picker
entries.summary: Pick a local file through a shared button; the caller owns upload.
constraints: Picking a file does not upload or publish it.

entries.name: Typed filters
entries.summary: Build filters from the entity's declared fields and operators.

entries.name: Flow observation
entries.summary: Inspect a native flow's graph, waiting steps and decision trace.

entries.name: Flow layout and toolbar
entries.summary: Wrap presentation items and navigate toolbar buttons with arrow keys.

entries.name: Form submission
entries.summary: Submit an ad hoc form on Enter without reloading the page.

entries.name: Read-only graph
entries.summary: Observe relationships and execution paths through the shared canvas.

entries.name: Input controls
entries.summary: Text, select and multiline controls for explicit labelled values.

entries.name: Sized layout regions
entries.summary: Arrange weighted regions with bounded dimensions and local scrolling, stacking columns in narrow containers.
constraints: The caller supplies validated dimensions and parent axes; layout grants no business access.

entries.name: Lifecycle status bar
entries.summary: Display declared record states and caller-allowed transitions.
constraints: Only the canonical action owner may authorize and apply a transition.

entries.name: Markdown display and editor
entries.summary: Read formatted content or edit its source with a shared preview.

entries.name: Metal button
entries.summary: Tactile metallic and liquid glass styled buttons for prominent actions.

entries.name: Notifications
entries.summary: Show unread changes and let the caller mark a notification as read.

entries.name: Page header
entries.summary: Give a task its title, description and visible actions.

entries.name: Cards and panels
entries.summary: Group related content with a shared heading, description and action area.

entries.name: Pivot table
entries.summary: Compare aggregate groups with totals and explicit drill-down.

entries.name: Authorized record calendar
entries.summary: Browse original business dates by month and day and select original records.
constraints: The caller owns the bounded window and record authorization; the calendar never writes dates or reads another collection.

entries.name: Record cards
entries.summary: Select original records from a caller-owned grid or list window.
constraints: Card fields come from permission-filtered metadata; the caller owns reads, selection and navigation.

entries.name: Ordered record chart
entries.summary: Plot original authorized records without merging equal axis labels or reading another collection.
constraints: The caller owns the ordered window, field permissions and point budget; this chart performs no reads or writes.

entries.name: Authorized event list
entries.summary: Present ordered original business events with explicit time and severity tones.
constraints: The caller owns the authorized window and business time; the list does not create events or read another collection.

entries.name: Entity form
entries.summary: Edit declared entity fields using their shared validators and editors.
constraints: The caller owns persistence, authorization and conflict handling.

entries.name: Authorized task Gantt
entries.summary: Present original ordered business intervals on an explicit fixed UTC range.
constraints: The caller owns the authorized window; this presentation does not reorder records, filter by the viewport, or write dates.

entries.name: Authorized lifecycle board
entries.summary: Select bounded records in their original lifecycle lanes and emit declared move commands.
constraints: The caller supplies authorized records, lifecycle states and actions. This component does not write state.

entries.name: Record list
entries.summary: Browse a scoped entity source with search, sort and paging.
constraints: An optional RecordEditPort supplies authorized displayed fields and the original revision-bound submit callback. Failed edits remain staged; the caller owns permissions and execution.
RecordColumnPresentation configures visible column titles, widths and typed formats without replacing field metadata or permissions. Hiding search retains the caller query.
RecordSelectionPort controls bounded selection in the current window; the caller confirms record permissions and owns pending, failure and cleanup. Window selection is not a complete matching set.

entries.name: Record lookup
entries.summary: Search a caller's scoped source to choose a reference by record ID.

entries.name: Record detail and history
entries.summary: Read a record's declared fields, related work and recorded changes.
constraints: Visibility and allowed actions come from the scoped source and caller.

entries.name: Authorized record timeline
entries.summary: Display a bounded record window as time points or intervals, grouped by an original resource field.
constraints: The caller supplies authorized records and selection. This component does not schedule or write records.

entries.name: Record list and detail
entries.summary: Keep record browsing and focused detail in one responsive task frame.
constraints: Pass a scoped RecordSource; this layout does not define a business entity.

entries.name: Retro button
entries.summary: Tactile mechanical keycap buttons styled after industrial equipment.

entries.name: Detail sheet
entries.summary: Inspect or edit details while keeping the underlying task in view.

entries.name: Semantic status tags
entries.summary: Map actual domain or kernel states to a label and one of five tones.
constraints: Use exact registry keys; unknown states fall back to a neutral label.

entries.name: Tasks and inbox
entries.summary: Present assigned work with the answers and actions supplied by its owner.
constraints: An inbox preview is not an approval or permission engine.

entries.name: Multiple choices
entries.summary: Switch several named choices on or off without a custom control.

entries.name: Hierarchy selection
entries.summary: Select a row from a small hierarchy of labelled records.
constraints: Rows are always expanded; collapse and full tree keyboard navigation are not implemented.

entries.name: Virtual item list
entries.summary: Render measured rows by stable identity and retain the focused item.
constraints: The caller owns data reads and item state; offscreen local inputs are disposed.

zh-CN.A labelled boolean choice with an explic: 带标签的布尔选择，支持明确的禁用状态。
zh-CN.A runtime call needs the actual host, a: 运行调用需要实际宿主、已发布能力版本及当前成员的权限。
zh-CN.A tenant object must be created, tested: 租户对象须在已连接的应用工坊创建、测试和发布。
zh-CN.Action conditions compare declared recor: 动作条件将已声明的记录路径或输入与固定值或兼容字段比较；关联读取和审批重试均走原动作及申请人当前权限。
zh-CN.Activate stable scoped presentation cont: 通过调用方拥有的绑定激活具有稳定身份的作用域呈现控件。
zh-CN.An inbox preview is not an approval or p: 收件箱预览不承担审批或权限引擎职责。
zh-CN.An optional RecordEditPort supplies auth: 可选 RecordEditPort 提供授权展示字段及绑定原记录版本的提交回调。失败修改仍保留暂存，调用方管理权限及执行。
zh-CN.Application owns scalar declarations and: 应用拥有标量声明和有界查询；页面通过类型化端口共享，只读窗口为成员作用域内的临时值。
zh-CN.Application resources refer to original: 应用资源引用原归属方；加入应用不会授予权限。发布审查通过原候选路径冻结已发布依赖。
zh-CN.Applications reuse Workspace; app naviga: 应用复用 Workspace；应用导航与视图由各自的 AppUI 声明提供。
zh-CN.Arrange a library, canvas and inspector: 组合组件库、画布与检查器，支持键盘和指针调整面板宽度。
zh-CN.Arrange weighted regions with bounded di: 以有界尺寸与局部滚动安排带权重的区域，在窄容器中堆叠列。
zh-CN.Ask for a bounded decision with focus tr: 用限制焦点范围、带标题的对话框完成有界决策。
zh-CN.Author fixed record conditions and retai: 编写固定记录条件，保留共享页面计划的明确查询版本。
zh-CN.Bind a published Go/Wasm operation to a: 按原能力契约将已发布 Go/Wasm 操作绑定到页面。
zh-CN.Browse a scoped entity source with searc: 通过搜索、排序和分页浏览限定范围的实体数据源。
zh-CN.Browse original business dates by month: 按月日浏览原业务日期并选择原记录。
zh-CN.Browse records, choose a record and save: 通过当前成员的宿主浏览和选择记录，并保存列表视图。
zh-CN.Browse, sort and edit typed rows in a sh: 在共享虚拟化表格中浏览、排序和编辑类型化行。
zh-CN.Build filters from the entity's declared: 从实体声明的字段和操作符构建筛选条件。
zh-CN.Card fields come from permission-filtere: 卡片字段来自权限裁剪后的元数据，调用方负责读取、选择及导航。
zh-CN.Choose an authorized object or property: 从现有注册表选择受权对象或属性，无需填写内部标识。
zh-CN.Choose several authorized options with c: 从授权选项中多选，显示完整来源计数及可选直方图。
zh-CN.Compare aggregate groups with totals and: 比较聚合分组，展示合计并提供明确的下钻。
zh-CN.Compose app navigation, routed tabs, com: 在同一外壳中装配应用导航、路由标签页、命令与会话上下文。
zh-CN.Compose nodes through typed ports with o: 通过类型化端口装配节点，使用统一的图交互模型。
zh-CN.Compose typed platform blocks with the e: 用现有原生流程编辑器和共享画布装配类型化平台区块。
zh-CN.Connect through the workspace Host. The: 通过工作区 Host 接入。目录预览使用本地示例，不授予权限。
zh-CN.Display a bounded record window as time: 将有界记录窗口显示为时间点或区间，按原资源字段分组。
zh-CN.Display declared record states and calle: 展示已声明的记录状态与调用方允许的跃迁。
zh-CN.Download the original JSON and mapping r: 离开编辑器前请下载原 JSON 和映射报告。报告在当前编辑作用域内保留，关闭或切换成员时清理。
zh-CN.Each control has a stable identity; the: 每个控件具有稳定身份，其绑定、权限及执行由调用方拥有。
zh-CN.Edit declared entity fields using their: 使用共享校验器和编辑器编辑已声明的实体字段。
zh-CN.Edit fields from the original object dec: 按原对象声明编辑字段，通过原动作提交。
表单参数读取已声明的记录路径。写入由原动作检查；来源不可用时不会改为手动输入。
zh-CN.Give a task its title, description and v: 提供任务标题、说明与可见动作。
zh-CN.Give an installed agent a goal; review i: 为已安装智能体设置目标，在确认前审核它提出的动作。
zh-CN.Group related content with a shared head: 通过统一的标题、说明和动作区域组织相关内容。
zh-CN.Inspect a native flow's graph, waiting s: 检查原生流程的关系图、等待步骤与决策轨迹。
zh-CN.Inspect a workflow's recorded version an: 沿成员原有读取权限，检查流程运行所记录的版本与启动发布。
zh-CN.Inspect and edit fields, lifecycle state: 通过现有对象设计器查看和编辑字段、生命周期状态、跃迁与权限。
zh-CN.Inspect or edit details while keeping th: 查看或编辑详情，同时保留原任务的上下文。
zh-CN.Inspect the original run trace, structur: 查看原运行轨迹、结构化草稿和跨应用执行关系。
zh-CN.Installed blocks, versions, permissions,: 已安装区块、版本、权限、测试和激活均来自已连接的原能力 API。
zh-CN.Keep record browsing and focused detail: 在响应式任务框架中同时保留记录浏览与聚焦详情。
zh-CN.Keep selection and detail together using: 使用原记录工作台或受控表格与详情区块，保持选择与详情连贯。
zh-CN.List selection is shared by details and: 详情和动作共享列表选择；对象契约和当前成员的读取范围仍为准。
zh-CN.Map a bounded source page into the origi: 使用显式绑定、来源保留及阻塞诊断，将限定范围的源页面映射为原生 V2 草稿。
zh-CN.Map actual domain or kernel states to a: 将真实领域或内核状态映射为标签与五种语义色调之一。
zh-CN.Named record selections keep same-object: 具名记录选择让同一对象的多个列表互不干扰；父来源绑定限定关联区块的范围。
zh-CN.Observe relationships and execution path: 通过共享画布观察关系和执行路径。
zh-CN.One action control with primary, quiet,: 一种动作控件，提供主要、弱化、危险、链接和列表行形态。
zh-CN.One field type owns display, editing, va: 一种字段类型统一负责展示、编辑、校验、排序与筛选。
zh-CN.Only the canonical action owner may auth: 只有规范动作的归属方可以授权并应用状态跃迁。
zh-CN.Open this full-window preview separately: 单独打开全窗口预览；外壳负责路由与保存的布局。
zh-CN.Organize navigation and shared published: 使用原应用编辑器组织导航及共享的已发布对象、流程和函数。
zh-CN.Pass a scoped RecordSource; this layout: 传入限定范围的 RecordSource；布局不定义业务实体。
zh-CN.Pick a local file through a shared butto: 通过共享按钮选择本地文件，上传由调用方负责。
zh-CN.Picking a file does not upload or publis: 选择文件不会上传或发布该文件。
zh-CN.Plot original authorized records without: 绘制原受权记录，不合并相同坐标标签，也不读取另一集合。
zh-CN.Present a record's title, status and lab: 展示记录的标题、状态和带标签的属性。
zh-CN.Present assigned work with the answers a: 展示分配的工作，以及其归属方提供的答复和动作。
zh-CN.Present ordered original business events: 以显式时间及严重度色调呈现排序后的原业务事件。
zh-CN.Present original ordered business interv: 在显式固定 UTC 范围呈现原排序业务区间。
zh-CN.Queries use the original record reader a: 查询使用原记录读取与成员权限；页面明确选择保留的来源版本，后续草稿与发布不会替换它。
zh-CN.Read a record with history, tasks and th: 查看记录、历史、任务和当前成员可执行的动作。
zh-CN.Read a record's declared fields, related: 阅读记录的已声明字段、相关工作与变更历史。
zh-CN.Read formatted content or edit its sourc: 阅读格式化内容，或通过共享预览编辑源码。
zh-CN.RecordColumnPresentation configures visi: RecordColumnPresentation 配置可见列的标题、宽度及类型化格式，不替换字段元数据或权限。隐藏搜索保留调用方查询。
zh-CN.RecordSelectionPort controls bounded sel: RecordSelectionPort 控制当前窗口的有界选择，由调用方确认记录权限并管理在途、失败及清理。窗口选择不代表完整匹配集合。
zh-CN.Reference links need a Workspace; attach: 引用链接需要 Workspace；附件上传需要调用方明确实现。
zh-CN.Render a visualization spec using inline: 使用内联值或限定范围的聚合数据源呈现可视化规格。
zh-CN.Render labelled editors and validate an: 呈现带标签的编辑器，并在提交前校验临时模式。
zh-CN.Render measured rows by stable identity: 按稳定身份呈现测量后的行，并保留当前聚焦项。
zh-CN.Render original Page sections with share: 按原 Page 区块共享选择和过滤状态；装配预览关闭写入。
zh-CN.Render original action payloads and offe: 展示原动作参数和可执行的状态跃迁，不重复定义角色规则。
zh-CN.Render the existing chart specification: 用原图表规范展示当前成员有权读取的聚合数据。
zh-CN.Results come from the current member’s h: 结果来自当前成员的宿主。离线示例只搜索合成记录。
zh-CN.Reveal supporting details while keeping: 显示补充详情，同时保留摘要。
zh-CN.Rows are always expanded; collapse and f: 所有行始终展开；尚未实现折叠与完整的树键盘导航。
zh-CN.Search a caller's scoped source to choos: 搜索调用方的限定范围数据源，按记录 ID 选择引用。
zh-CN.Search records and knowledge through the: 通过当前成员的原读取入口搜索记录与知识。
zh-CN.Select a record, inspect its details and: 选择记录、查看详情，并使用原对象动作。
zh-CN.Select a row from a small hierarchy of l: 从小型记录层级中选择一行。
zh-CN.Select bounded records in their original: 在原生命周期列中选择有界记录，并发出已声明的移动命令。
zh-CN.Select original records from a caller-ow: 在调用方拥有的网格或列表窗口中选择原记录。
zh-CN.Share declared presentation state across: 在同一受控应用实例的页面间共享声明式展示状态。
zh-CN.Show a declared collection name and its: 显示声明的集合名称及调用方提供的完整计数。
